text:
leo (partnerships): FYI we just got a packet from Integrator Y with 9 pre-qualified accounts. They marked 4 as "co-sell" and 5 as "referral". Need to finalize the claim + commission rules before we touch these.
sara (revops): can you drop the list? i'll run through SFDC owner lookups.
leo (partnerships): pasted redacted: Meridian Health, Cloudline Retail, Vega Logistics, Solis Energy...
dev (sales): quick ask: if Integrator runs the tech POC and our AE runs commercial, who books the opp in SFDC? both? we should avoid duplicate opps.
sara (revops): operational rule suggestion: single-opportunity model. The person who creates the opp is primary owner; integrator gets Partner_Referral__c and a Partner_Claim__c record linked. We track contribution via Partner_Role__c = "SI_POC".
leo (partnerships): that'd work. we also need to declare an exclusivity window for integrator-led deals. my propose: 45 calendar days from claim acceptance. During that period SI has first right to run technical activities; commercial pursuit remains collaborative.
dev (sales): 45 days seems short for long-tail enterprise POCs. Can we make it 60, but with a clause: if RWAE has existing active relationship (last activity < 180 days), then RWAE maintains commercial priority?
kai (legal): for papering exclusivity we should avoid open-ended terms. recommend: standard MSA addendum with a 60-day technical-first period + clear definition of "active relationship" (e.g., any closed/won or active opportunity in SFDC in last 180 days). Also include revenue split hook for introduced deals.
sara (revops): for commission tagging: set Partner_Influence__c = "SI_originated" when integrator schedules a POC within 10 business days of claim acceptance. That drives partner payout rules.
leo (partnerships): good. also flag marketplace-sourced leads separately. Integrator must not claim marketplace leads unless specifically routed. add `lead_origin_detail` field on intake.
dev (sales): automation: if Lead.Partner__c = 'Integrator Y' AND Lead.Claim_Status__c = 'Accepted' THEN set Claim_Expiry__c = Today + 60 days and create task for RWAE to confirm commercial involvement within 7 days. If RWAE confirms -> collaborative opp; if not -> SI-primary opp.
sara (revops): i can build that workflow. will need mapping for Partner_Role__c values. hooking to payout automation too.
kai (legal): we'll draft the MSA addendum template and a short partner claim form that integrator signs when they submit lead batches. keeps it crisp.
handoff-bot: created PartnerHandoff-ID: PY-192000 for Integrator Y batch.
leo (partnerships): propose weekly triage with Integrator Y on Tues 9am PT — 20m. we'll surface urgent conflicts there.
dev (sales): +1. please include a column in the spreadsheet for "existing_rw_relation (yes/no)" so we can catch edge cases.
sara (revops): i'll spin up the SFDC sandbox changes next week and share the deploy plan.
kai (legal): will circulate draft addendum by EOD Thursday for comments.
leo (partnerships): perfect. i'll post the intake CSV in #partnerships and tag Integrator Y for claim confirmation. thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
dev (sales): :thumbsup:
end
